title: Tab
summary: One tab of an pk-tabs. Place it inside pk-tabs; it selects its panel by value. It can show a count, a close button, and appear only on a phone or only on a desktop.

props.name: value
props.description: The key that pairs this tab with the pk-tab-panel of the same value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Cannot be selected or focused by arrow keys.

props.name: count
props.description: A badge shown in muted parentheses after the label (a queue count); empty shows none.

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows a close button; pk-tab-close is raised when it is clicked and the page removes the tab.

props.name: only
props.description: all shows the tab everywhere; phone only at phone width (640px and below); desktop hides it at phone width.

events.name: pk-tab-close
events.description: The close button of a closable tab was clicked.

cssProperties.name: --pk-tab-fg
cssProperties.description: Text colour of an unselected tab.

a11y: Exposes role=tab, aria-selected and aria-disabled through ElementInternals. pk-tabs manages tabindex (roving) and aria-controls. The close button is outside the tab order (tabindex -1) and labelled; keyboard users close a tab from the page's own command.

examples.title: Inside pk-tabs
examples.html:
<pk-tabs value="a">
  <pk-tab value="a" count="12">Pending</pk-tab>
  <pk-tab value="b" closable>Draft</pk-tab>
  <pk-tab value="c" disabled>Locked</pk-tab>
  <pk-tab-panel value="a">Pending content</pk-tab-panel>
</pk-tabs>
